message.reasoning_content: need to determine crime(s) based on facts: selling expired meat (over 3 months?) large amount. This is a food safety violation. In Chinese criminal law, selling expired food is a crime of "生产、销售假冒伪劣食品" or "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". In examples, they used "生产、销售假药" for fake drugs, "生产、销售假药" etc. For expired meat, likely "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" (selling unsafe food). Could also be "非法经营" but typical classification: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品罪". So answer: [罪名]生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>
